title: Hybrid Retrieval Evaluation Harness with Regression Gate
instructions: Implement `BM25`, `rrf`, `hybrid`, `ndcg_at_k`, `evaluate` and `regressions` in `rag_eval.py` (`tokenize` and the two dataclasses are provided). A retriever is just `Callable[[str], list[str]]`, so one `evaluate` scores a vector search, BM25 or a fused hybrid on a golden set (recall@k, MRR, nDCG@k), and `regressions` flags metrics that dropped beyond a tolerance for a CI gate.

evidence.label: rrf prefers documents ranked well by several lists
rrf breaks ties by id, handles empty input and sums 1/(k+rank)
BM25 ranks the rare-token document first and returns every document once
BM25 ties keep the original document order
ndcg_at_k matches known values and caps the ideal DCG at k
evaluate averages recall@k, MRR and nDCG@k over the golden queries
Hybrid recall@3 is 1.0 while dense and BM25 each fall short
hybrid fuses retrievers into a retriever and keeps a single ranking intact
evaluate rejects an empty golden set
regressions reports only drops larger than the tolerance
